crossRefs.note: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go…
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh…
Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to…
These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according…
Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, who you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted…
Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt…
You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses…

parallels.note: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

translations.web: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
translations.bsb: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
translations.kjv: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
